game_concept: A puzzle set in Coastal Port – Customs House, the port customs house: the shipwright must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Customs House: the port customs house
core_gameplay_loop: In Customs House, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the harbor bell using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The harbor bell reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the harbor bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Customs House'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Customs House.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The harbor bell reached with actions_used <= 11.
